where: the Mac: other lanes' builds while measuring
what: Another lane's cargo build ran on the Mac for about half an hour of this lane's measurements (load average 20 to 55 on 18 cores): `/usr/bin/true` went from 1.9 to 4.5 ms and every row about doubled, Relax's too. `/tmp/blaze-inst`, which the brief named as the baseline binaries, was replaced by another build at 23:18.
cost: two measurement runs thrown away, and a build of the base for the before rows
cause: the Mac is shared by lanes that build and lanes that time
workaround: check `/usr/bin/true`'s median before each run and report the load average with the rows; build the base into this lane's own install directory
